ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Child Care Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of fraud in child care programs across the US, with a focus on Minnesota and Nebraska.
questions: What is the extent of fraud in child care programs?
How much federal funding is at risk?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in child care programs, which could have significant implications for the millions of children and families who rely on these programs.
